JUNEAR Privacy Notice & GDPR Article 8 Parental Consent Framework

Effective Date: November 15, 2026 · Policy Version: 1.0 · bond.gabba.junear

This Privacy Notice explains clearly and transparently how data controller Bányai Gábor processes and safeguards personal data of children aged 6–14, Co-Parents, Extended Family members, and Classroom Teachers across the JUNEAR (bond.gabba.junear) ecosystem exclusively inside the European Union (eur3).

Four Core JUNEAR Child-Privacy Guarantees

100% EU (eur3) Residency

All Firestore databases and Storage buckets run exclusively in the European Union (eur3 / europe-west) across isolated junear-prod and junear-dev projects.

Zero AD_ID & Zero Profiling

com.google.android.gms.permission.AD_ID is stripped in AndroidManifest.xml (tools:node="remove"). Zero ads, zero behavioral analytics, zero data brokers.

Local-First Camera (<= 250 KB)

Zero auto-upload: child photos stay LOCAL_ONLY on the phone unless the child explicitly taps "Send to Family", compressing to <= 250 KB WebP.

Strict Teacher GDPR Wall

Classroom teachers have cryptographically enforced 0% access to child GPS, family photos, phone whitelists, call logs, or peer/family chats.

1. Verifiable Parental Consent Under GDPR Article 8 (Pre-Activation Gate)

Because JUNEAR is engineered for children aged 6 to 14, no child profile or device can be activated without prior, explicit declaration of parental responsibility by the legal guardian.

  • Unchecked-by-default activation gate: Both Android (GdprOnboardingScreen) and the Co-Parent PWA (GdprConsentGate) block progression until the parent actively ticks the GDPR Article 8 Parental Responsibility declaration.
  • Three independent language-aware legal links: Terms (/junear/terms?lang=hu|de|en), Privacy (/junear/privacy?lang=hu|de|en), and Operations (/junear/operations?lang=hu|de|en) open independently in a new tab without toggling the consent checkbox.
  • Persisted compliance audit fields: Strictly five audit fields are recorded: legalAccepted: true, parentalAuthorityDeclared: true, legalAcceptedAt (ISO-8601 UTC), legalPolicyVersion: "1.0", and legalAcceptedLang ("hu" | "de" | "en").

2. 100% European Union Data Residency (eur3) & Google Play Families Compliance

Every JUNEAR serverless database and object storage bucket operates exclusively inside the European Union on Google Cloud eur3 (europe-west) infrastructure, strictly separating development (junear-dev) and production (junear-prod) environments.

In full compliance with the Google Play Families Policy, JUNEAR explicitly strips com.google.android.gms.permission.AD_ID at manifest merge time. No third-party advertising networks, cross-app trackers, or behavioral profiling SDKs are permitted anywhere in the codebase.

3. Data Minimization & Complete Inventory of Processed Data

Under GDPR Article 5(1)(c) data minimization, JUNEAR processes strictly the minimum technical fields required to deliver child safety and multi-adult coordination:

4. Multi-Adult Role Isolation & Strict Classroom Teacher GDPR Privacy Wall

JUNEAR enforces cryptographic role boundaries in firebase/firestore.rules and storage.rules across Co-Parents, Extended Family, and Classroom Teachers:

Adult RoleAuthorized ScopeCryptographically Forbidden Scopes (PERMISSION_DENIED)
Co-Parents (coParentUids — 2+ Equal Admins)Full read/write over E.164 whitelist, Double-Parent Handshake, homework rewards, 1-Tap Vacation/Sick-Day override, geofences & Anti-Brick unlock.Zero access to other families.
Extended Family / Grandparents (familyMemberUids)Read-only Family Photo Wall (<= 250 KB WebP) and approved whitelist calling.Zero access to MDM policies, GPS coordinates, peer chats, or secrets/offlineUnlock.
Classroom Teacher (teacherUids — via classCode)Strictly within allowedSchoolWindow when vacationOrSickMode == false: writes ONLY the narrow 5-field schoolSession/live doc (Focus Lock + 45-min educational app unlock).STRICT 0% ACCESS: GPS/location, sharedPhotos (!isTeacherRole), phone numbers/whitelist, call logs, peer/family chats, home schedules & offline unlock secret.

5. Local-First Camera & Double-Parent Handshake Messaging Safeguards

  • Zero background photo sync: The JUNEAR camera module never auto-uploads child photos. Unshared photos remain strictly LOCAL_ONLY under a local storage cap. Tapping "Send to Family" compresses the image on-device to <= 250 KB image/webp enforced by storage.rules.
  • Double-Parent Handshake peer messaging: No child-to-child chat channel can exist until Co-Parents of both families approve the friendship. Outgoing messages are filtered to block web URLs/TLDs and phone numbers, while ages 6–7 (and SYMBOLS_ONLY mode) use safe voice notes and vector stickers only.

6. Data Retention & Automated Minimization

  • Active family & child records: Retained in eur3 only while the family account remains active or until a Co-Parent exercises erasure under GDPR Article 17.
  • Shared family photos & live classroom sessions: Shared WebP photos can be deleted individually at any time; schoolSession/live overwrites strictly 5 live state fields without building a classroom surveillance log.
  • Statutory tax invoices: Billing invoices are retained for 8 years under applicable EU/Hungarian accounting law and contain zero child profile or telemetry data.

7. Parental & Data Subject Rights and EU Supervisory Authorities

Legal guardians (and children, age-appropriately) hold the right of access (Art. 15), rectification (Art. 16), erasure / right to be forgotten (Art. 17 — available at /junear/delete-account), restriction (Art. 18), data portability (Art. 20), and withdrawal of consent at any time (Art. 7(3)).

All requests are handled directly via info@gabba.bond. You also have the right to lodge a complaint with your national EU Data Protection Authority, including NAIH in Hungary (ugyfelszolgalat@naih.hu), DSB in Austria (dsb@dsb.gv.at), or BfDI / state authorities in Germany.
